purpose: Protected test-only handoff for pausing and resuming one feed relay without losing history

protectedFiles.change: Existing child-module registration; hash refreshed against the reviewed merged tree; file unchanged in this follow-up

commands.discovery: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --test feed_pause_resume_acceptance --test feeds --test feeds_connector --locked -- --nocapture
commands.runtime: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot --bin two-bot --locked feed_jobs::tests::pause_resume_acceptance_tests:: -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.pollerControls: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot --bin two-bot --locked feed_jobs::tests:: -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

database.fixture: two_bot_testsupport::TestDatabase with cutover migrations and independent pools
database.missingEnvironment: Fails explicitly; no acceptance test is ignored or silently skipped
database.ciRoute: check.yml normal unit/binary step supplies the guarded disposable DB URL; normal integration step discovers the core target
database.boundaries: Only disposable DB and loopback REST doubles; never live Discord or staging/production databases

contract.authorization: The same guild-management authority as add/remove; stable relay IDs remain guild-scoped
contract.preservation: Only lifecycle state changes; preserve URL, destination, seen-item/high-water and delivery/nonce history
contract.pause: Serialize against relay fetch/send admission; enabled plus pending recovery refuses and remains enabled; already-paused plus pending stays byte-identical and reports already_paused; admitted work is not cancelled
contract.resume: Persist across restart, restore pending recovery discovery without settlement, do not repost accepted items, and retain a bounded documented catch-up policy
contract.strictIds: Runtime refuses missing, duplicate distinct strings, mixed integer/string in both orders and lone integer ids without any relay, delivery or audit change; names id with the command-specific invocation; unknown options are ignored and a typed empty string remains planner rejected
contract.audit: Exact action/target/outcome triples for pause paused/already_paused/missing/recovery_required/rejected and resume resumed/already_resumed/missing/rejected; malformed options emit no audit
contract.list: Expose enabled/paused state, every stable ID and source identity with bounded whole-row pages
contract.controls: Existing source-address SSRF, URL, mention and pending/uncertain-send settlement fences stay intact

handoff: Do not merge the deliberately failing test-only branch by itself.
Consume the pinned handoff commit read-only in an isolated Builder workspace. Do not edit protected tests; return corrections to the test author.
This follow-up changes only the protected runtime tests and manifest; all 17 original runtime tests and every original assertion remain.
The Builder owns the implementation, registration/help/lifecycle docs and exact-head GREEN in one combined implementation PR.
Observed RED/control/cache-refusal results are recorded on the acceptance card, never inferred from this manifest.
